nodes.name: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Fires daily at 23:00 in the workflow timezone (Asia/Karachi, set via GENERIC_TIMEZONE) = 18:00 UTC. The GitHub Action scrapes one region per weekday at 06:00 UTC, but GitHub starts scheduled runs 5-7 hours late (13:18 UTC at the latest in the run history), so 18:00 UTC is after that day's shard has merged into the CSV. Daily, not weekly: five shards land on five different days, and the upsert is idempotent. (It was weekly Monday 12:00 = 07:00 UTC, which fetched the previous week's file.)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (domain, company_name, country, source, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'ichgcp', 'ingested')
ON CONFLICT (domain) DO UPDATE SET
  company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name,
  country = EXCLUDED.country,
  updated_at = now()

nodes.name: Upsert into leads
nodes.notes: Only sets status/source on first INSERT. A lead that has already progressed past 'ingested' (enriched/scored/etc.) is left alone on re-runs -- re-running the weekly scrape must not regress pipeline state for leads it has already seen.
